evidence_summary: Monitor check #138 verified via commit 81bc03bdbe040401a5ddc62f2596c688f537b975 and monitor_174k_state.json. Formal suite results (evaluation_174k_formal_suite_latest.json) match cycle report v30 for all 8 TF-IDF representations at 173,963 decisions. Dense partial evaluation (dense_partial_2000_2015_eval_latest.json) verified: lang_dom=0.9855 FAIL, zero-shot NMI=0.293 PASS, per-language NMI=0.444 PASS. HNSW artifact fix confirmed: adversarial benchmarks use exact k-NN on fixed stratified subsample (n=2000, seed=42). Legal-distance dependency: 16/26 years complete (2000-2015), 99,325/173,963 decisions (57%). CITATION HERITAGE DISCREPANCY: Two methodologies produce conflicting results — Method 1 (exact k-NN, k=20, all pairs): AUC 0.49-0.97, recall@20 0.00-0.49; Method 2 (HNSW, k=10, sampled 5000): AUC 0.49-0.90, recall@10 0.00-0.05. Prior audit correction (CYCLE_36242734524) incorrectly labeled Method 1 results as 'fabricated'. This cycle inherits the confused state but did not introduce it. Cycle report v30 accurately reflects monitor state; CONTINUE_RECOMMENDED=false is justified.
